method: Every line of every file in the baseline tree was read. Content lines are mapped to the issues below; structural/navigation/CSS/workflow lines are separately classified in line_audit.csv. The audit does not treat a prior 'done' or 'verified' label as evidence.

issues.title: USD 50,000 facilitation quota presented as a universal outbound cap
issues.correction: Separate settlement, domestic-individual purchase, foreign-individual documented RMB income, account remittance and cash rules. Foreign individuals generally do not have a USD 50,000 purchase facilitation quota; documented lawful current-account income is the relevant route. Confirm the bank's individual classification.

issues.title: Blanket 'no US tax' / 'not a taxable event' claims
issues.correction: Moving previously reported principal is not a second income item, but underlying income/gain and CNY disposition under IRC 988 must be analyzed. The personal-transaction gain exception is narrow and fails when gain exceeds USD 200.

issues.title: Invented 1%–3% FX spread and USD 15–50 wire estimates
issues.correction: Remove practice estimates. Use BOC's published tariff components and leave customer-specific FX, routing, tax and all-in USD totals blank. A historical Federal Reserve rate is not a retail quote.

issues.title: China illegal-FX fines misstated as 30%–300% and 30%–500%
issues.correction: Under the cited Regulations: evasion and illegal FX trading are ordinarily up to 30%, serious cases 30%–100%; cash-export violation is warning plus up to 20%; unauthorized business has separate penalties. Do not present a universal multiplier.

issues.title: Family quota splitting suggested as a lawful above-quota option
issues.correction: Remove quota borrowing/splitting advice. Genuine family support must be evaluated on its own facts; relabeling one's own savings to use another person's quota is not a verified lawful route.

issues.title: Cash carrying described as 'no cost' and customs declaration treated as permission
issues.correction: Separate China RMB 20,000 / FX USD 5,000 declaration references, SAFE permit bands, BOC permit fee/waiver, and US FinCEN 105 >USD 10,000 aggregate family/group declaration. Declaration is not tax and not export authorization.

issues.title: Western Union and MoneyGram combined and direct US-bank delivery assumed
issues.correction: WU's official China page verifies partner-bank outbound service and cash-pickup instructions, not a personalized US-bank deposit quote. MoneyGram outbound remains unverified after the attempted official URL returned 404.

issues.title: PayPal China personal CNY-to-USD savings route assumed
issues.correction: The China C2 homepage and fee schedule do not verify mainland bank CNY funding to a US personal savings account. The USD 35 withdrawal fee is only a balance-withdrawal component, not a route quote.

issues.title: Alipay/WeChat outbound availability left vague and conflated with other products
issues.correction: Alipay's official international-remittance page describes a domestic-individual quota product; foreign-passport eligibility and current fees are unverified. WeChat's official cross-border page is merchant acquiring, not personal savings remittance. Wise funding via Alipay is separate.

issues.title: Crypto workaround described as technically fast and only old 2021 notice cited
issues.correction: Exclude the CNY-to-crypto-to-USD exchange/business workaround. Cite current PBOC 2026 No. 42, which repeals 2021 No. 237. Do not claim passive ownership is universally criminal; the proposed exchange route is the problem.

issues.title: FBAR penalty amounts cited without official adjustment authority and per-violation unit unclear
issues.correction: Use current eCFR adjusted maxima USD 16,536 / USD 165,353 effective for assessments on/after 2025-01-17, not a newly announced 2026 amount. Bittner holds non-willful penalties accrue per report, not per account; willful rules and reasonable cause are separate.

issues.title: Form 8938 penalty timing and threshold labels incomplete
issues.correction: State strict 'more than' thresholds, filing-status and presence-abroad conditions, 90-day notice period before continuing penalties, and that Form 8938 attaches to the return while FBAR is separate.

issues.title: FEIE stale 2025 figure and overbroad treaty/FTC relief language
issues.correction: Use 2026 maximum USD 132,900, earned-income/tax-home/residence-or-presence limits, no double benefit with FTC, and treaty eligibility/saving-clause analysis. FTC does not automatically eliminate US tax.

issues.title: Form 3520 gift/trust rules oversimplified
issues.correction: Distinguish foreign individual/estate >USD 100,000, 2026 entity threshold USD 20,573, related-party aggregation, trust parts/penalties, covered-expatriate section 2801 tax, and separate filing deadlines. A loan label alone does not prove non-gift treatment.

issues.title: Streamlined/delinquent compliance relief promised too broadly
issues.correction: Streamlined requires non-willful certification and eligibility; examination/investigation can bar it. Do not promise reduced/no penalties or rely on removed delinquent-FBAR assurances.

issues.title: Obsolete SAFE mirror and repealed RMB 1,000 fallback penalty used as current authority
issues.correction: Use the amended SAFE consolidated text. Article 39 fallback penalty was repealed by Huifa [2023] 8; do not cite it as current. Replace secondary practice guides with regulator/operator primary sources.

issues.title: Missing property, migration, inheritance, dividend, trade and RMB routes
issues.correction: Add source-matched routes and procedures. Property-sale bank review replaced obsolete SAFE approval; migration/inheritance require competent-branch approval; 2026 dividend rule changes PRC withholding; genuine trade and current-account RMB have distinct rules.

issues.title: China tax discussion reduced to 3%–45% salary withholding
issues.correction: Add residence test, passive/property categories, savings-interest exemption, property basis/relief, and 2026 FIE dividend change. Do not apply salary rates to transfer principal.

issues.title: Closed-loop investment channels absent or potentially misusable
issues.correction: Add WMC Southbound and QDII as unsuitable for free USD disposal: WMC returns to paired mainland account; QDII is an institutional investment channel, not a personal remittance workaround.

issues.title: Source registry mixes primary, secondary and stale official pages without effective-date control
issues.correction: Publish a registry with publisher, locator, access status, what it establishes and caveats. Mark operator terms as operator evidence, not law. Flag stale PayPal fees, old BOC promo, future ATM change and superseded dividend FAQ.

issues.title: Malformed checklist and weak mobile/accessibility structure
issues.correction: Remove stray td inside ul. Generated pages use landmarks, skip link, one h1, labeled table regions, horizontal scroll containers, visible focus, and no JS dependency for core content.

issues.title: Pages workflow deploys without rebuilding or checking the site
issues.correction: Run data build, unit tests and site checks before uploading the Pages artifact. Keep deployment gated on passing checks and verify the live site after merge.

issues.title: README and coordination labels do not expose audit evidence or reproducible commands
issues.correction: Document build/test commands, data policy, deployment and audit coverage. Preserve historical coordination entries but record the independent re-audit and corrected status.

issues.title: Executive summary lacks source-first decision path and complete amount tables
issues.correction: Put the source-of-funds decision path first, link category pages, and publish 40 rows for every method plus a complete CSV. Unknown numeric cells remain blank and flagged.
